title: Bell showcases the 407GXi & 505 at luxury Salon Privé Concours
summary: Bell brought luxury aviation to one of the U.K.’s most exclusive automotive and lifestyle events, showcasing its VIP and premium travel options.
body_markdown:
Global helicopter manufacturer Bell Textron Inc. returned to Salon Privé at Blenheim Palace, Oxfordshire, England for one of the United Kingdom’s most prestigious luxury automotive events.


Bell showcased two static models at this year’s show: the[Bell](https://www.bellflight.com/products/bell-407)[407GXi](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407gxi) Designer Series and the[Bell 505](https://www.bellflight.com/products/bell-505) , reinforcing Bell’s long-established aerial presence in the United Kingdom. The Bell[407GXi](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407gxi) Designer Series is Bell’s foremost luxury platform in the commercial sector, and the Bell[505](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/505) is one of Bell’s best-selling models for a variety of utility cases.


With more than 30,000 anticipated guests, Bell’s attendance at the event showcased how luxury automotive and aviation brands share a deep commitment to precision engineering, bespoke service and high-performance travel.


Robin Wendling, managing director, Europe, said: “For several years, we’ve greatly enjoyed participating in Salon Privé. Set in a stunning Oxfordshire location, the event’s luxury focus and the boutique nature of the brands present make it an easy and natural choice for us. Showcasing the Bell[505](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/505) and the Bell[407GXi](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407gxi) at Salon Privé highlights Bell’s position as a leader in VIP and high‑end helicopter travel.”


Earlier last month, Bell marked the[700th sale of the Bell 505](https://news.bellflight.com/en-US/268373-bell-marks-the-delivery-of-the-700th-bell-505-during-farnborough-international-airshow/) during Farnborough International Airshow, one of the United Kingdom’s largest aviation events. It also shared the company secured the[first IFR-configured Bell](https://news.bellflight.com/en-US/268454-bell-celebrates-the-first-ifr-configured-bell-407gxi-order-in-the-united-kingdom/)[407GXi](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407gxi) order in the United Kingdom, which is an indication of Bell’s continued popularity in the region.


Bell’s presence on the famous lawns of Blenheim Palace at this year’s Salon Privé was a change from traditional aviation shows, with a focus towards automotive luxury and VIP experiences. With a keen focus on quality, craftsmanship, premium customer care and exceptional aftersales experience, prospective customers had the opportunity to meet a dedicated product team for a full introduction to Bell’s products and the ownership experience.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Bell.*
